distribution.summary: Anhui; Chongqing; Fujian; Guangxi; Guizhou; Hunan; Jiangxi; Sichuan; Yunnan; Taiwan
distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) records Ambrosiophilus osumiensis from Anhui, Chongqing, Fujian, Guangxi, Guizhou, Hunan, Jiangxi, Sichuan, Yunnan and Taiwan. Beaver & Liu (2010) independently documents Taiwan under two source names now mapped to VSN_0272. Smith et al. (2022) independently reports the same reviewed province and region set, adding source support without changing the current distribution synthesis.

host_note: Current genus-level host synthesis from Smith et al. (2020) is retained. Beaver & Liu (2010) reports the host of Ambrosiophilus hunanensis as unknown and gives no host for Ambrosiophilus metanepotulus, so no host update is made.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Ambrosiophilus osumiensis (Murayama, 1934).

nomenclature_note: Beaver & Liu (2010) treated Ambrosiophilus hunanensis and Ambrosiophilus metanepotulus as new combinations in their Taiwan treatment. These source-specific names are preserved as nomenclatural provenance but map to the same current VSN_0272.
